editorial: Tag (2018) is a wild comedy about five grown men who have been playing the same game of tag since first grade. Every May, they drop everything and chase each other across the country. This year, the game lands on Jerry's wedding weekend, and Jerry has never been tagged in thirty years. He is fast, sneaky, and ready for them. The movie is loud, silly, and full of crazy stunts. The cast includes Ed Helms, Jake Johnson, Hannibal Buress, Jon Hamm, and Jeremy Renner, and they all look like they are having a blast. The action scenes are over the top and funny, with slow-motion fight moves that feel like a superhero movie. The jokes land often, though some gags repeat. It is not deep, but it is a fun ride. If you want a light movie night with friends, this is a great pick. Stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture.
endingExplained: During Jerry's wedding, his wife Susan fakes a miscarriage to distract the guys, but they see through it. Hoagie finally tags Jerry in the middle of the reception, ending his undefeated streak. The friends celebrate together, and the movie closes with real footage of the actual friends who inspired the story. It is a sweet, funny finish that reminds you the game was always about staying close.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves silly buddy comedies and over-the-top action gags.
